title: Quality Executives
description:
**Quality Executive** 




**Company:** 
  Vashini Agro Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
  Pollachi
 



**Employment:** 
  Full\-time, factory\-based
 



**Vacancies:** 
  2 positions
 



**About the role** 




 Quality in food manufacturing depends on people who notice the details, ask the right questions and follow through. At Vashini Agro, we are looking for Quality Executives who want to apply their knowledge and contribute to safe, consistent food production.
 



 You will join our Quality Assurance team and work closely with production and other departments, checking quality from incoming raw materials through to finished products. This role suits someone who enjoys practical work, values accurate records and is willing to speak up when something needs attention.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Inspect raw materials, in\-process materials and finished products against quality requirements.
* Conduct or support microbiological, physical and chemical testing, as applicable.
* Monitor hygiene, cleaning, sanitation and housekeeping practices on the factory floor.
* Check adherence to standard operating procedures, GMP, GHP, HACCP and food safety requirements.
* Maintain accurate inspection records, test reports and quality documentation.
* Identify and report quality or food safety concerns, and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Support investigations into customer complaints and non\-conformities, including corrective and preventive actions.
* Assist with internal and external audits, regulatory inspections and traceability activities.
* Coordinate with external laboratories when required.
* Contribute to practical improvements in quality and food safety.



**Qualifications** 




 A relevant qualification in Food Technology, Food Science or Microbiology, such as:
 


* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in Microbiology or Food Science \& Technology.
* B.Tech. / M.Tech. in Food Technology.
* Other relevant food science or microbiology qualifications.



**Experience** 




 1–2 years of relevant experience in food processing, quality assurance, quality control, food testing or microbiology laboratories. Experience with fresh produce or food products is preferred.
 



**Freshers with strong relevant practical knowledge may also be considered.** 




**Required knowledge and skills** 



* Understanding of food safety, HACCP, GMP and GHP.
* Basic knowledge of microbiological testing and food quality parameters.
* Careful documentation and record maintenance.
* Basic working knowledge of MS Excel and MS Word.
* Clear communication and the ability to work with production and operations teams.
* Attention to detail, responsibility and a willingness to learn.
* Readiness to work in a factory environment and follow hygiene and safety procedures consistently.



**Why this work matters** 




 Your checks, records and observations help the team make informed decisions about food quality and safety. The role brings you close to the manufacturing process and provides opportunities to apply your technical knowledge to real production situations.
 



 We welcome candidates who take pride in doing work carefully, approach problems constructively and want to deepen their understanding of food manufacturing.
 



**How to apply**
